title: GW5 roundup
body:
*GAMEWEEK 5 — ROUNDUP*

———

*RESULTS*

Adam 56 – 33 Jack
Edmund 37 – 53 Iain
Giles 31 – 49 Tom
Brian 29 – 50 Calum

———

*STANDINGS*

1. Iain (Marshmellow3.0) — 4-0-1, 12 pts (229 for)
2. Jack (The Beauties) — 3-0-2, 9 pts (218 for)
3. Adam (Diomande Eyes XI) — 3-0-2, 9 pts (213 for)
4. Calum (Ndiaye Hart) — 2-0-3, 6 pts (236 for)
5. Edmund (115 Love Notes XI) — 2-0-3, 6 pts (218 for)
6. Brian (Sesko Meal Deal) — 2-0-3, 6 pts (210 for)
7. Tom (Lord Farsquaad) — 2-0-3, 6 pts (206 for)
8. Giles (Quantum of Tzolis) — 2-0-3, 6 pts (194 for)

———

*THE GAMES*

*Adam 56 – 33 Jack*
Adam by 23.
Adam: led by Hall (13), Cunha (10), Alisson (8); 10 left on the bench, Verbruggen the pick of them.
Jack: led by Barry (6), Stach (5), Mykolenko (5); 14 left on the bench, Kelleher the pick of them.
Adam eased past Jack behind Hall's 13 and a tidy 10 from Cunha, with Alisson chipping in 8 more for good measure. Jack's bench of 14 sat heavy and useless, Kelleher warming a seat that could have used him, while Barry, Stach and Mykolenko toiled without support to close a 23-point gap.

*Edmund 37 – 53 Iain*
Iain by 16.
Edmund: led by Groß (14), De Cuyper (6), Belloumi (4); 1 blank (Giles); 18 left on the bench, Kostoulas the pick of them.
Iain: led by Barnes (9), Pickford (8), Isak (8); 1 blank (Wissa); 16 left on the bench, Trafford the pick of them.
Edmund lost by 16 with 18 unused on the bench.
Iain's 16-point win came on the back of Barnes, Pickford and Isak all chipping in solidly, a rare balanced spread rather than one standout. Edmund leaned entirely on Groß's 14 and had precious little else to show for it, and with 18 players left unused on the bench the real story is a squad that never got going.

*Giles 31 – 49 Tom*
Tom by 18.
Giles: led by Van Dijk (8), Justin (8), Gakpo (3); 1 left on the bench, Merino the pick of them.
Tom: led by Semenyo (17), Vuskovic (8), Mitchell (7); 11 left on the bench, Schade the pick of them.
Tom's win was built almost single-handedly by Semenyo's 17, with Vuskovic and Mitchell tidying up behind him, while Schade watched on from a bench that never had to be called upon. Giles got token contributions from Van Dijk and Justin but Gakpo's 3 summed up a night short on firepower, going down by 18.

*Brian 29 – 50 Calum*
Calum by 21.
Brian: led by Jacquet (6), Bogle (5), Lacroix (3); 7 left on the bench, Ndiaye the pick of them.
Calum: led by Brobbey (17), Tarkowski (14), Cherki (8); 3 blanks (J.Timber, M.Sangaré, Flemming); 3 left on the bench, Horníček the pick of them.
Calum strolled to a 21-point win with Brobbey's 17 doing the heavy lifting alongside a hefty 14 from Tarkowski, despite three blanks from Timber, Sangaré and Flemming barely denting the total. Brian's response was modest by comparison, Jacquet's 6 the high point of an afternoon where Ndiaye's promise never left the bench.

———

*STAR MAN* — Semenyo (MCI), 17 pts, for Tom

*Top starters:* Semenyo 17; Brobbey 17; Tarkowski 14; Groß 14; Hall 13

*Lowest starters:* Wissa 0; M.Sangaré 0; J.Timber 0; Giles 0; Flemming 0

*Points left on the bench*

Edmund — 18
Iain — 16
Jack — 14
Tom — 11
Adam — 10
Brian — 7
Calum — 3
Giles — 1

———

Iain leads at 4-0-1 while still finding room to leave 16 on the bench.

Six of eight managers now sit on 6 points, which is less a title race than a queue.

Calum's 236 for is the league's best attacking return, propping up a 2-3 record that suggests the defence is elsewhere.

Giles benched precisely 1 point all week, which is either total conviction or nothing to choose from.

Jack's 14 unused sit second only to Edmund's 18 — between them, enough for a decent Sunday roast, wasted.

*GAMEWEEK 4 — ROUNDUP*

———

*RESULTS*

Jack 53 – 40 Giles
Brian 37 – 72 Edmund
Calum 31 – 46 Adam
Tom 37 – 40 Iain

———

*STANDINGS*

1. Jack (The Beauties) — 3-0-1, 9 pts (185 for)
2. Iain (Marshmellow3.0) — 3-0-1, 9 pts (176 for)
3. Brian (Sesko Meal Deal) — 2-0-2, 6 pts (181 for)
3. Edmund (115 Love Notes XI) — 2-0-2, 6 pts (181 for)
5. Giles (Quantum of Tzolis) — 2-0-2, 6 pts (163 for)
6. Adam (Diomande Eyes XI) — 2-0-2, 6 pts (157 for)
7. Calum (Ndiaye Hart) — 1-0-3, 3 pts (186 for)
8. Tom (Lord Farsquaad) — 1-0-3, 3 pts (157 for)

———

*THE GAMES*

*Jack 53 – 40 Giles*
Jack by 13.
Jack: led by João Pedro (12), Gabriel (9), Tavernier (8); 2 blanks (Dedić, N.Jackson); 14 left on the bench, Kinsky the pick of them.
Giles: led by Van Dijk (8), Rogers (8), Igor Jesus (7).
Jack cruised behind João Pedro's 12 and a fine 9 from Gabriel, with Tavernier chipping in 8, while Giles never quite got enough from Van Dijk and Rogers to close the gap. Fourteen players left warming Jack's bench, Kinsky among them, suggests the margin could have been even wider.

*Brian 37 – 72 Edmund*
Edmund by 35 — never in doubt.
Brian: led by Emersonn (12), Saka (8), Palmer (5); 17 left on the bench, Bogle the pick of them.
Edmund: led by Groß (17), De Cuyper (11), Kostoulas (10); 12 left on the bench, Leno the pick of them.
Edmund's 35-point win was built on Groß's 17, with De Cuyper and Kostoulas adding 11 and 10 apiece to put the game beyond doubt early. Brian's response, an Emersonn-led 12 with support from Saka and Palmer, was tidy but nowhere near enough against that kind of firepower.

*Calum 31 – 46 Adam*
Adam by 15.
Calum: led by Tarkowski (8), Murillo (6), Calafiori (6); 1 blank (Foden); 3 left on the bench, Sels the pick of them.
Adam: led by Calvert-Lewin (10), Haaland (9), Alisson (9); 1 blank (Hall); 12 left on the bench, Verbruggen the pick of them.
Adam edged it thanks to Calvert-Lewin's 10 and useful returns from Haaland and Alisson, while Calum's Tarkowski, Murillo and Calafiori trio kept things respectable but not competitive. Foden's blank for Calum won't have helped matters.

*Tom 37 – 40 Iain*
Iain by 3.
Tom: led by Raya (14), Vuskovic (6), Mainoo (4); 1 blank (Mukiele); 7 left on the bench, McBurnie the pick of them.
Iain: led by Gvardiol (11), Rúben Dias (6), Branthwaite (6); 18 left on the bench, Robertson the pick of them.
Tom had 7 on the bench and lost by 3. Work that one out.
Iain's Gvardiol led the way with 11, backed up by six apiece from Dias and Branthwaite, just enough to see off Tom despite Robertson and seventeen others doing nothing from the bench. Tom's Raya top-scored with 14, but with seven players left unused and a 3-point defeat, questions will be asked about team selection.

———

*STAR MAN* — Groß (BHA), 17 pts, for Edmund

*Top starters:* Groß 17; Raya 14; João Pedro 12; Emersonn 12; Gvardiol 11

*Lowest starters:* N.Jackson 0; Mukiele 0; Hall 0; Dedić 0; Foden -2

*Points left on the bench*

Iain — 18
Brian — 17
Jack — 14
Edmund — 12
Adam — 12
Tom — 7
Calum — 3
Giles — 0

———

Jack and Iain sit level on points at the top, nine apiece, with four teams stacked on six behind them.

Calum has 186 for, more than anyone in the league, and 3 points to show for it.

Giles left nothing on the bench, a tidy zero, and still lost by 13.

Between them Iain, Brian and Jack carried 49 unused points into the bin this week.

Four teams on 2-0-2, so the middle of this table currently means nothing at all.

title: GW3 roundup
body:
*GAMEWEEK 3 — ROUNDUP*

———

*RESULTS*

Iain 44 – 40 Jack
Adam 42 – 49 Tom
Edmund 43 – 32 Calum
Giles 45 – 36 Brian

———

*STANDINGS*

1. Brian (Sesko Meal Deal) — 2-0-1, 6 pts (144 for)
2. Iain (Marshmellow3.0) — 2-0-1, 6 pts (136 for)
3. Jack (The Beauties) — 2-0-1, 6 pts (132 for)
4. Giles (Quantum of Tzolis) — 2-0-1, 6 pts (123 for)
5. Calum (Ndiaye Hart) — 1-0-2, 3 pts (155 for)
6. Tom (Lord Farsquaad) — 1-0-2, 3 pts (120 for)
7. Adam (Diomande Eyes XI) — 1-0-2, 3 pts (111 for)
8. Edmund (115 Love Notes XI) — 1-0-2, 3 pts (109 for)

———

*THE GAMES*

*Iain 44 – 40 Jack*
Iain by 4.
Iain: led by Isak (13), Gvardiol (8), Rúben Dias (6); 7 left on the bench, Branthwaite the pick of them.
Jack: led by Tavernier (10), Guéhi (8), N.Williams (7); 9 left on the bench, Kinsky the pick of them.
Jack had 9 on the bench and lost by 4. Work that one out.
Iain edged this thanks to Isak's 13 and a solid platform from Gvardiol and Dias, but the story is Jack's bench — nine players left out there, with Kinsky apparently deemed less useful than whoever did play. Tavernier's 10 and Guéhi's 8 kept it tight, but four points is four points, and Jack will be replaying that team sheet in his head for a while.

*Adam 42 – 49 Tom*
Tom by 7.
Adam: led by Haaland (9), Alisson (8), Rice (5); 14 left on the bench, King the pick of them.
Tom: led by Janelt (11), Mbeumo (8), Havertz (8); 1 blank (Thiaw); 24 left on the bench, Vuskovic the pick of them.
Adam had 14 on the bench and lost by 7. Work that one out.
Tom's 49 came on the back of Janelt's 11 and a tidy 8 apiece from Mbeumo and Havertz, enough to see off Adam despite Haaland's 9. The real puzzle belongs to Adam, though — 14 points stranded on the bench with King left unused, in a defeat by exactly 7. Some questions don't need answering out loud.

*Edmund 43 – 32 Calum*
Edmund by 11.
Edmund: led by Ødegaard (10), Giles (8), Tzolakis (6); 3 left on the bench, Leno the pick of them.
Calum: led by Murillo (8), Sels (6), Tzolis (5); 2 blanks (M.Sangaré, Osula).
Edmund cruised here, Ødegaard's 10 doing the heavy lifting alongside decent returns from Giles and Tzolakis, and a bench barely worth mentioning. Calum's afternoon was undermined before it started, with Murillo and Sels doing what they could but two blanks from M.Sangaré and Osula proving too much to carry.

*Giles 45 – 36 Brian*
Giles by 9.
Giles: led by Gakpo (11), Donnarumma (7), Van Dijk (6); 1 blank (Merino); 1 left on the bench, Hincapie the pick of them.
Brian: led by Suzuki (10), Egan (6), Šeško (5); 1 blank (Georginio); 3 left on the bench, Martinez the pick of them.
Giles made it a comfortable nine-point win, Gakpo's 11 setting the tone and Donnarumma and Van Dijk chipping in, with only Merino blanking. Brian could point to Suzuki's 10 as a bright spot, but a blank from Georginio and three points left unused on the bench meant Šeško's 5 was never going to be enough.

———

*STAR MAN* — Isak (LIV), 13 pts, for Iain

*Top starters:* Isak 13; Janelt 11; Gakpo 11; Ødegaard 10; Tavernier 10

*Lowest starters:* Osula 0; Merino 0; M.Sangaré 0; Georginio 0; Thiaw -1

*Points left on the bench*

Tom — 24
Adam — 14
Jack — 9
Iain — 7
Edmund — 3
Brian — 3
Giles — 1
Calum — 0

———

Four teams unbeaten in normal terms, three ways to lose, and Calum still sits fifth on 155 points for.

Tom's 24 on the bench is the largest total anyone's managed this season, and he won anyway.

Brian tops the table despite the defeat to Giles; for-and-against clearly does its job elsewhere.

Nobody at the bottom is short of scoring, just short of picking the right XI on the day.

Calum has more points for than anyone in the league and a 1-0-2 record to show for it.

*Jack 40 – 39 Edmund*
Jack by 1.
Jack: led by João Pedro (9), Gabriel (8), N.Williams (6); 2 left on the bench, Kinsky the pick of them.
Edmund: led by Gibbs-White (13), Lewis-Potter (6), Truffert (4); 1 blank (De Cuyper); 2 left on the bench, Strand Larsen the pick of them.
Edmund had 2 on the bench and lost by 1. Work that one out.
Jack edged this by the narrowest of margins, João Pedro's 9 and Gabriel's 8 doing the heavy lifting. Edmund will be kicking himself, mind, sat there with Strand Larsen and company warming the bench while Gibbs-White's 13 wasn't quite enough to get him over the line.

*Giles 33 – 52 Adam*
Adam by 19.
Giles: led by Ajayi (6), Rogers (5), Gakpo (5); 1 blank (Donnarumma); 1 left on the bench, Merino the pick of them.
Adam: led by Haaland (13), Cunha (9), Calvert-Lewin (8); 1 blank (Alisson); 11 left on the bench, Elanga the pick of them.
Adam cruised to a comfortable win, Haaland's 13 and Cunha's 9 setting the tone, though quite why Elanga and ten others were left kicking their heels on the bench in a 52-point haul is anyone's guess. Giles never really got going, Ajayi's 6 as good as it got, and a blank from Donnarumma didn't help matters.

*Brian 51 – 44 Iain*
Brian by 7.
Brian: led by Saka (11), Egan (9), White (7); 2 left on the bench, Suzuki the pick of them.

Brian made light work of this one, Saka's 11 and a solid 9 from Egan doing the damage. Iain will want a word with whoever set his lineup, though: Wissa and Isak both weighed in with 8 apiece, yet ten players were left unused on the bench while the team fell seven short.

*Calum 77 – 42 Tom*
Calum by 35 — never in doubt.
Calum: led by Bruno Fernandes (23), Cherki (14), Tarkowski (12); 2 blanks (Tzolis, Osula).
Tom: led by Mbeumo (11), Mukiele (9), Raya (6); 19 left on the bench, Neto the pick of them.
Calum strolled to a 35-point win with Bruno Fernandes running the show on 23, well backed by Cherki's 14 and Tarkowski's 12. Tom never threatened, Mbeumo's 11 the standout in a losing effort, and with 19 points left stranded on the bench including Neto, there will be some quiet reflection on selection this week.

Two unbeaten teams, and Brian tops the table on for and against alike.

Tom sits bottom with 71 for, 19 of it left on his own bench.

Three of four games this week were single-figure margins; Calum's wasn't one of them.

Calum leads the league for points scored, 123, and still has a losing record to show for it.

*THE GAMES*

*Tom 29 – 52 Jack*
Jack by 23.
Tom: led by Raya (6), Havertz (6), Wilson (3); 2 left on the bench, Roefs the pick of them.
Jack: led by João Pedro (11), Dewsbury-Hall (11), Guéhi (10); 1 blank (Muñoz); 14 left on the bench, Tavernier the pick of them.
Tom's Lord Farsquaad side never got out of first gear, with Raya and Havertz both stuck on 6 and Wilson chipping in a modest 3. Jack's Beautiful Boys were altogether more comfortable, João Pedro and Dewsbury-Hall both hitting 11 while Guéhi added 10, leaving a bench of 14 largely academic. Tom will want to know why Roefs was left warming the pine while Raya laboured.

*Iain 48 – 46 Calum*
Iain by 2.
Iain: led by Xhaka (9), Gvardiol (9), Pickford (7); 14 left on the bench, Trafford the pick of them.
Calum: led by Calafiori (9), Cherki (8), Tzolis (6); 2 left on the bench, Sels the pick of them.
A tight one at the top, settled by the narrowest of margins. Iain's Xhaka and Gvardiol both weighed in with 9 apiece and Pickford's 7 proved just enough, while Calum's Calafiori matched the best of them with 9 but Tzolis's 6 wasn't quite sufficient to close the gap. Two points, decided perhaps by team selection rather than talent.

*Adam 17 – 57 Brian*
Brian by 40 — never in doubt.
Adam: led by Rice (3), Tielemans (2), Scott (2); 2 blanks (James, Kerkez); 6 left on the bench, Verbruggen the pick of them.
Brian: led by Palmer (13), White (11), Saka (9); 2 blanks (Frimpong, Marmoush).
Adam's Diomande Eyes never threatened, with Rice's 3 the high point of a limp scoreline further hampered by blanks from James and Kerkez. Brian's Sesko Meal Deal were ruthless by comparison, Palmer's 13 and White's 11 doing the heavy lifting as Saka chipped in 9, making this one look over before it started.

*Edmund 27 – 45 Giles*
Giles by 18.
Edmund: led by Ødegaard (11), Gravenberch (5), Lewis-Skelly (3); 2 blanks (Cash, Thiago); 3 left on the bench, Leno the pick of them.
Giles: led by Gakpo (12), Szoboszlai (8), Rogers (8).
Edmund's 115 Love Notes leaned heavily on Ødegaard's 11, but with Gravenberch and Lewis-Skelly managing only 5 and 3 respectively, and blanks from Cash and Thiago, there wasn't enough support. Giles's Quantum of Tzolis were more evenly spread, Gakpo's 12 backed up by Szoboszlai and Rogers both hitting 8, enough to see this one home comfortably.

———

*STAR MAN* — Palmer (CHE), 13 pts, for Brian

*Top starters:* Palmer 13; Gakpo 12; Ødegaard 11; White 11; João Pedro 11

*Lowest starters:* Marmoush 0; Kerkez 0; James 0; Frimpong 0; Cash -1

Four wins, four losses, and already a table that flatters no one equally.

Brian tops the pile on 57 without needing his bench, which feels unfair on the other seven.

Jack and Iain leave 14 apiece on the bench and still win; Giles and Brian leave none and also win, so no lesson there.

Cash goes to -1 for Edmund, a rare achievement in round one.

Bottom three separated by two points, which is either a tight league or a shallow one.
